narr: Initially it was an isolated severe thunderstorm that straddled the Chase and Morris county line, but there was additional thunderstorm development as it tracked to the east and southeast. This storm produced quarter sized hail and very heavy rainfall that led to flash flooding in the northeast corner of Chase County.
ev: Emergency manager reported water flowing over ZZ Road north of Highway 50.
lsr: Reported water over ZZ gravel road north of highway 50.
